fast_cut.description: High pacing cuts, prioritizing main dialogues

delayed_reaction.description: Delay the cut after dialogue to capture late emotional reaction

emotional_carry_over.description: Let the emotional atmosphere carry over to the next scene

silence_after_emotion.description: Leave a brief silent gap after a highly emotional fragment

tension_release.description: Transition from high tension to a relaxed pace

emotional_wave.description: Alternating pacing matching the wave of dramatic events

emotional_pause.description: Insert a deliberate pause during emotional peaks

observational_hold.description: Hold on the subject observing their environment without cut

breathing_landscape.description: Let scenery clips breathe, acting as emotional resets

reflective_gap.description: Insert silent space for viewers to reflect on narrative points

scenic_reset.description: Use scenic shots between major structural chapters to reset rhythm

narrative_breathing.description: Allow natural breathing pauses in speech fragments

visual_memory_callback.description: Call back to visually similar scenery or cues

emotional_bridge.description: Use reaction shots or silent close-ups to bridge narrative peaks

contrast_transition.description: Abrupt rhythm or context change to create contrast

anticipation_hold.description: Hold tension before a key dialogue or action sequence

slow_reveal.description: Gradual introduction of scenery or subject
